cot_trace: We need 14 vertices, exactly 3 vertex-disjoint cliques each size 3 => total vertices used = 9. But we have 14 vertices, each vertex must belong to one of these cliques, impossible because 14 not divisible by 3 and need exactly 3 cliques of size 3 uses only 9 vertices, leaving 5 vertices unassigned, violating requirement.
